mechanism_narrative: A four-week monotonic decline in WORKPLACES, from +1.3 to -1.7, signals erosion of office and commuting routines that reduces weekday retail footfall, so RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
failure_condition: If the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is greater than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days while WORKPLACES continues its four-week decline.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT falls below -10.5, as in t-0w at -11.1, it indicates tightened mobility restrictions or strong avoidance; discretionary retail trips fall further, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT <= -10.5 for at least one week
failure_condition: If the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is greater than or equal to its mean over the last 14 days when TRANSIT <= -10.5.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of rising RESIDENTIAL and falling TRANSIT captures voluntary at-home behavior: households substitute home time for retail trips, so the joint signal predicts lower RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is greater than or equal to its mean over the last 14 days when RESIDENTIAL > 7.0 and TRANSIT < -10.5.

mechanism_narrative: Under a tightening-restrictions regime signaled by PARKS falling more than 4 points week-on-week (from -38.3 to -43.1), retail and recreation venues face capacity limits; continued tightening lowers RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is greater than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days after a PARKS week-on-week drop of at least 4 points.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal weather suppresses PARKS and outdoor leisure, but as the season transitions RETAIL_REC recovers from its current low base; the next four weeks should show higher RETAIL_REC than the last four weeks.
failure_condition: If the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days despite PARKS remaining below -35.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM staying near +10 while WORKPLACES turns negative indicates households are consolidating trips to essentials; this substitution persists and drags RETAIL_REC lower over the next week.
failure_condition: If the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is greater than or equal to its mean over the last 7 days while GROCERY_PHARM > 9 and WORKPLACES < 0.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of RESIDENTIAL above +7.5 and TRANSIT below -10.0 signals a durable shift to home-centered routines; because retail trips require transit, this joint condition predicts lower RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is greater than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days when RESIDENTIAL > 7.5 and TRANSIT < -10.0.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES crosses below 0 for two consecutive weeks, as at t-1w and t-0w, it signals work-from-home directives or office closures; reduced lunchtime and after-work spending lowers RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is greater than or equal to its mean over the last 14 days when WORKPLACES < 0 for two consecutive weeks.
